result.title: Rewire benchmark data
result.description: Reviewed biological benchmark records (models, methods, configurations, benchmarks, tasks, protocols, datasets, evaluations, results, sources and claims) as RDF, with OWL 2 RL inferences in a separate graph, discrepancies between studies' results in a derived graph, and what the release serves as use-case evidence in a release graph.

graphs.description: Discrepancies between studies' results found by the rules in scripts/kg/contradictions.py, with their review state and follow-up actions. Each is a lead for review, not a finding that a result is wrong.
Facts derived from the asserted graph by the ontology when the bundle was built.

What the release serves, copied from its use-case file: the evaluations behind each active direct or proxy relevance judgement (rb:servedEvaluation), each use case's reviewed baseline methods (rb:servedBaseline), and the sources of run receipts on executed full-protocol run recipes (rb:runReceipt). A judgement in the asserted graph with no served evaluation is withheld.

inferred.kept: New statements about records in the rewire vocabulary: rb: links and rb: types. Superclasses and superproperties from imported vocabularies are left to the ontology graph. Protected links are never inferred.

example_queries: Results for a system, with assessment and dataset

result.title: MFASS v2 corrected k-mer and position baseline on CPU

recipe.title: MFASS v2 corrected k-mer and position baseline on CPU
recipe.summary: Prepares the MFASS v2 protocol from the two published MFASS tables, fits the registered k-mer and position baseline on the training split and scores the 8,324 held-out variants.

licence.weights: No pretrained weights; the baseline is fitted on the training split.
licence.data: Reuse terms are unreported upstream (KosuriLab/MFASS). The data is fetched, not redistributed.

hardware_floor.note: CPU only. Measured on 2026-11-20 on an Apple M4 (macOS arm64) by this recipe: 21.6 seconds including the input download, peak resident memory 0.83 GB. Disk was not measured; the two inputs total 80 MB.

expected_output.description: The corrected baseline values published in benchmarks/mfass/README.md, on all 8,324 held-out variants with 315 positives.

weights_pin.note: The baseline uses no pretrained weights.

estimate.note: No GPU and no paid compute.

limitations: A rerun with the project's own code and data, not an independent reproduction by another group.
The local backend runs in the host Python environment, not in the published image the recipe names.

results.detail: code.commit is null; the code tree was not clean; recipe.commit is null

result.note: Verification shows the folder is consistent with its receipt and, for a recipe run, with the recipe. Nothing is signed: hardware, times and who started the run are as trustworthy as the place the folder came from, and a metric the recipe does not check can be changed together with its digests. Checked values are read again from the output files; predictions are not scored again, because the prepared data is not in the folder. The commits check reads the commit the receipt states and does not look it up.
